name: Corvin
description: Sword of the Lake, twenty-two, earnest and brave and not remotely subtle. Rows well. Currently in a brown coat that is too short in the arm and sulking about it.
actor_notes:
Corvin
LOOKS: Twenty-two, Sword of the Lake in white, open honest face. Rows extremely well and would like that mentioned.
CORE: A young man who took vows for entirely sincere reasons and is privately terrified that when the moment arrives he will turn out not to be equal to it.
NATURE: Eager, warm, a bit too loud, genuinely good-hearted. Picks up the heavy end of things before anyone asks and occasionally before anyone wants. Agrees to things he has no authority to agree to. Believes the best of people and is right about it more often than the cynical expect.
WOUND: Nothing has happened to him yet. That is the wound -- he has no evidence about himself and he needs some.
WANTS: To be the one who turned out to be useful.
PRESSURE: He acts first. Steps in, takes the weight, gives away the thing he was told to keep -- and you can watch him arrive, a beat late, at what he has just done.
KEY: "I'll come. I should probably ask first. I'll come."
